Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Sanjay - 34 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Karan - 62 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
3. Kavita - 33 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Hema - 31 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Shalini - 62 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Sanjay stands by the road. Shalini and Hema stand near him.]

Shalini: "Sanjay, what's the plan today?"

[Sanjay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Shalini (gently): "What next?"

[The thug's knife wounds Sanjay in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Sanjay (laughing): "And then?"

[Sanjay's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Sanjay: "Show me too!"

[Sanjay wades through the knee-deep water.]

Sanjay: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The potter's yard - Day

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Sanjay: "Careful!"

[Sanjay paints the clay lamps.]

Sanjay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
